name: Make Inverse Operator
summary: Computes an MNE minimum-norm inverse operator for MEG/EEG source reconstruction from a forward solution, a noise covariance and sensor info from epochs, using MNE-Python.
description: Combines a precomputed forward solution and a noise covariance with the channel layout and projectors of an epochs (or evoked) file in mne.minimum_norm.make_inverse_operator, and saves inv.fif with an HTML report. Use it between the forward/covariance Apps and source estimation. loose, depth and rank are passed to make_inverse_operator.

inputs.description: Epoched data used only for sensor information (channels, projectors).

parameters.description: Loose orientation constraint passed to make_inverse_operator ('auto' or a value from 0 to 1).
Depth weighting exponent passed to make_inverse_operator.
Data rank passed to make_inverse_operator (None estimates it).

citations.text: Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7(267):1-13 (2013).
